stories.title: Supreme Court rules to loosen campaign finance restrictions
stories.summary: In a 6-to-3 vote — along ideological lines — the court overturned limits on how much political parties can raise and spend in coordination with candidates.

stories.title: Footballers donate socks to hooves in need
stories.summary: The U.K. football club Arsenal have donated dozens of socks — to a donkey and horse sanctuary.

stories.title: Belfast violence: What to know about the fascist youth groups known as 'active clubs'
stories.summary: Racist mob violence in Northern Ireland earlier this month has drawn keen interest from extremist groups and figures in the U.S.

stories.title: These church members disagree on politics. Together they're wiping out medical debt
stories.summary: Trinity Moravian Church, a politically diverse congregation in Winston-Salem, N. C., has been raising money to retire medical debt in the surrounding community.

stories.title: Life Kit: How to handle the heat wave
stories.summary: Extreme heat will blanket a majority of American states through the July 4 weekend, according to forecasters. Learn how to keep cool, hydrated and safe in soaring temperatures.

stories.title: Egg producers settle with DOJ, states over price-fixing complaint
stories.summary: Seventeen states and the Department of Justice have settled a case of alleged price-fixing by major egg producers. Egg prices soared in recent years but have since fallen sharply.
